preconditions.description: The sizes n and m satisfy 1 <= n <= m <= 200000.
Permutation a has length n and permutation b has length m.

preconditions.expression: set(a) == set(range(1, n + 1)) and set(b) == set(range(1, m + 1))
preconditions.description: a contains exactly the integers 1 to n, and b contains exactly the integers 1 to m.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == len([d for d in range(-m, m + 1) if is_subsequence([x + d for x in a], b)])
postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct integers d such that the sequence (a1+d, a2+d, ..., an+d) is a subsequence of b.
